name: Shokushu To Love-Ru
source:
The being from Tentacle planet's objective is to violate Lala, and impregnate her with his own child. 
Sukekiyo's objective is Sairenji's body.
With common interests, the two of them unite body and hearts.....
And so, the veritable feast of tentacle sex begins.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041939.html]DLsite English[/url]]
